contact_comparison.scope: Intact original-CAD contact at half/quarter original timestep; unchanged law and tolerances

transfer.scope: Original 47-patch objective reference force transfer to FEM nodes; no coupled dynamics, closure or eligibility-detector pass

tangent_reset.scope: Exact reference tangent pullback and component history/reset; no loaded simulator reset qualification

interface_coverage.scope: Negative control of interface quadrature coverage, independent of bulk stiffness
interface_coverage.interpretation: Original quadrature transfer alone cannot resist every resolved interface opening mode. A constant-gap coupon does not qualify this full discretization. New surface quadrature or kinematic constraints are required; either changes the discrete model.

full_surface.scope: Approved full-surface original-law candidate component checks; no closure or dynamic qualification

quadrature_refinement.scope: Prescribed nonuniform smooth opening, 3 versus 12 quadrature points per triangle; not a dynamic refinement

contact_history.scope: Applied-nodal-force eligibility adapter and irreversible state controls, prescribed inputs; not a real blade-cut test

closure_fixture.scope: Existing research closure algorithm on new split geometry, prescribed piece translations only

factored_control.scope: Same force/operator and step, old versus factored preconditioner

window_reference.scope: Full-surface cohesion plus research cut-face contact, damage disabled; bounded unloaded assembled check

factored_200us.scope: Full-surface cohesion plus research cut-face contact, damage disabled; bounded unloaded assembled check
